title: Leopard Maxi Skirt & Velvet Crop
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight light brown hair parted in the center walks through a warm interior with framed prints and a patterned carpet. She wears a burgundy velvet long-sleeve crop top with a fitted waist, a wide leopard-print maxi skirt with a black belt, and carries a black handbag. A pendant necklace sits at her throat. Her expression is calm and direct. Warm, golden lamp light. Palette of burgundy, leopard tan, and deep brown. Bold and cozy, in the style of a 1990s sitcom still.
workingNotes:
- The leopard maxi skirt and velvet crop are the bold contrast.
- Keep the framed prints for a warm, lived-in interior.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the framed prints for a lived-in interior.
